thesis: The page is a pad of tracing vellum laid over your idea: every section is one more sheet, and with each sheet you scroll the drawing underneath is redrawn sharper, until the last sheet is healed skin.

signature.name: Tracing Sheet Stack + Register Mark
signature.summary: Semi-opaque vellum sheets with offset peeking edges, pencil register crosshairs and numbered tabs (01 idea, 02 drawing, 03 stencil, 04 lines, 05 healed); stencil violet appears only where a line is transferred. Hero sheet over the sticky photo, process stack redraws an SVG botanical from scribble to healed line, estimator result sheet over a drawn limb, review slips, form steps as stacked sheets, footer sheet 06.

layoutMoves: Sections are stacked sheets: each band overlaps the previous by 24-40px with the sheet edges beneath peeking out top-left
A 1-column left register rail on desktop carries the sheet number and word (01 idea ... 06 yours) instead of section eyebrows
Asymmetric 5/7 plates: framed photo plate under a translucent sheet, never full-bleed text-on-photo
Pinned 5-sheet process stack over one SVG drawing that is redrawn per sheet
Reviews as overlapping vellum slips in a staggered diagonal column, not a card grid

motion.intro: h1 present at paint; a stencil-violet transfer line draws under the first statement (650ms) while the tracing sheet settles 10px and gains its blur (520ms); skipped on reduced motion
stories: stack: pinned process (>=900px, 5*55svh+100svh) where each vellum sheet slides up and lands and the SVG sprig beneath is redrawn scribble -> clean -> violet stencil -> ink -> healed
draw: healing timeline line draws day 1 -> 42 with day dots ticking as it enters view
motion.hover: sheet lift: translateY(-4px) while the peeking edge beneath grows 6 -> 10px, 200ms ease-out
